nodes.long_description:
No legs. Long arms. One flashlight.

You're a proboscis monkey in an abandoned research facility, and something down there hunts you back. Push off the floor, swing up walls and climb with your arms through labs, sewers, mines and caverns, all the way down to the Depths.

HUNT. HAUL. GET PAID.
Monsters roam the dark, each hunting its own way: Zombies in groups, a Screecher that screams for help, a Mimic that looks like one of your crew, and worse. Rarer ones glow and pay more, up to the Mythic. Bring one down, haul it back to the hub, and everyone in the hub gets paid.

NEW: DIMENSIONS
Step through THE HUB into four strange worlds: THE PYRAMID, THE STATION, THE HUMWAYS and THE PANEL. No weapons there. Grab the objectives, hide, learn each monster's weakness and reach the exit before your battery runs out. Ten new monsters, plus a new class that can charm them.

GEAR UP
Spend credits on tools at the supply booth and on hats, glasses, vests, backpacks and fur colours at the lockers. Earn trophies on the challenge board. Players who first play before 2027 get the OG cosmetics.

PLAYERS VS MONSTERS
Team battles: monkeys against players who come back as a random monster every life.

PLAY TOGETHER
Up to 12 players per room, public or private with a code, with Quest and PC cross-play. Public rooms put you in open voice chat with other players, including strangers. Turn your mic off at the room computer or on the SUBJECTS board, and mute anyone from their name tag.
nodes.short_description: Co-op VR horror for up to 12 players, with cross-play between Quest and PC. You're a proboscis monkey in an abandoned research facility who gets around on long arms alone. Swing and climb through the dark, track down the creatures that live there with your crew, and bring them back to the hub for credits. Spend them on tools and cosmetics, or step through into the new Dimensions. Curiosity kills.

nodes.change_log:
v18, DIMENSIONS + LOVER: Curiosity Kills is now on PC with cross-play. New Dimensions to explore, ten new monsters, the new LOVER class, new monster animations and lots of fixes.

NEW
- NOW ON PC WITH CROSS-PLAY: Quest and PC players can play in the same rooms.
- DIMENSIONS: go through THE HUB into new worlds: THE PYRAMID, THE STATION, THE HUMWAYS and THE PANEL. No weapons there. Grab the objectives, hide, use each monster's weakness and reach the exit before your ANTI-GLITCH battery runs out.
- TEN NEW MONSTERS: THE MUMMY, THE SACRIFICE, THE MARTIAN, THE HUMMER, THE MILDEW, THE STILL, THE EXIT, THE DRIFTER, THE STRETCH and THE BOOM. All of them are in the MONSTER INDEX and in Monkeys vs Monsters, and now and then one comes through a rift into the facility.
- THE LOVER CLASS: CHARM a monster for a few seconds and revive teammates faster. She hits a little softer and moves a little quicker. With the MAID OUTFIT, the MANGA fur, ROSE BRAID HAIR and a SHADED look.
- NEW MONSTER ANIMATIONS: every monster moves with its own new gait.
- New Dimension cosmetics, plus the ALIEN MONKEY and MOBY MONKEY furs. They fit every class (TAILOR).

FIXED AND IMPROVED
- Titan health bars now go down as they should.
- The lightning gun can hit a monster that is partly behind cover.
- You can keep levelling past level 100.
- Facility monsters that rarely appeared now show up properly.
- Smoother online play, and many menu, sound and cosmetic fit fixes.

Everyone in a room needs v18: v17 and v18 players can't join each other.

v17, NEON MAZE ESCAPE + THANKSGIVING: the new NEON MAZE ESCAPE mode with THE GHOST MONKEY (REVIVE, NIGHTMARE MODE), the THANKSGIVING HUNT with THE GOBBLER, HUMPTY DUMPTY, the LOCKER HUB (daily SHOP, PASS, LEADERBOARDS), 12 new emotes and voice changers, cross-progression, a new look for every menu, STORM polish and many fixes. Everyone needs v17 to play together.

"v16.1 hotfix: fixes 'unable to join room - different version' so v16 players can join each other again (private codes, quick play and public rooms), clearer message when versions really differ, and cross-play with the upcoming Steam version. Everyone in a room should update."

"v16, THE CORDON UPDATE: STORM THE CORDON (16 players on the new CORDON BASE map, with team cutscenes), an end-of-match podium with your stats, the CORDON set and weapons, SUPER GORILLA, a MAIN MENU, account linking (your first link unlocks SUPER GORILLA for free), THE HEADLESS HORSEMONKEY for Halloween, more mall with the GECKI boutique, a Curious Creator pack, and many fixes. Everyone in a room needs v16 to play together."

"v15, the big one: GEMS and a new CREDITS pad, every shop is now a touch screen, a filled-out mall with food, rides, pets and the RAVE CAVE, THE SURFACE with two titans, the FOUNDER'S PACK, CLASSES, THE TROOP, six new monsters, a new fitting system for clothes, and lots of new cosmetics and challenges.

NEW
- GEMS: a new currency for cosmetics and the Curio Pass. Everyone gets starter gems, gem packs are on the new CREDITS pad, and the Curio Pass now has DAILY and WEEKLY GEM CHALLENGES. Credits stay the currency for gameplay.
- Shops are touch screens with icons, stats and prices: the SUPPLY BOOTH (everything from the old gun shop is here now), LAST LAP, PETS, RECORDS, EVENTS, WAGON RENTALS and the FOOD COURT. Weapon toy looks moved into the LOOKS tab of the cosmetics menu.
- The mall: foods cost credits and give a timed boost (in Survival they also heal), LAST LAP rides, pets (including the baby RAFTLING), pets in Survival, and the RAVE CAVE with THE DJ and DJ MON'S THEME.
- THE SURFACE: take the SURFACE LIFT at level 20 (or ride along from level 15). Meet the titans THE MAW and THE HOLLOW, find THE CONTRACTOR's hidden room, and use the JETPACK, the CROSSBOW and the POISON CROSSBOW. Surface challenges and lore included.
- THE FOUNDER'S PACK: gold and white founder items, HAULZILLA as a full-body fur, the WEREMONKEY, the FOUNDER KNIGHT and FOUNDER HORSE, the FOUNDER WINGS, plus founder perks: double daily and weekly gems and 3 FOUNDER'S DAILIES.
- CLASSES: NORMAL, BRUTE, SUPPORT and CLIMBER, each with its own body, head and face. The DOUBLE TROUBLE classes pack is on the CREDITS pad.
- THE TROOP: an AI monkey crew for your private co-op and Survival rooms. Name them, rename them, and they follow you and open doors, even on the Surface.
- MONSTER PICK: choose your monster in Monkeys vs Monsters.
- New monsters: THE WARDWING, THE RIOT, THE GLARE, THE HURLER, THE SNATCHER and THE TRIARCH (with its free TRIARCH STEEL wrap). Every one is in the MONSTER INDEX, which has new pages and poses.
- The RIOT SHIELD item and THE PHONE.
- New cosmetics: SOCK MONKEY, PLAGUE DOCTOR, THE STITCHED SET, ANTLER WRAITH, PUNK and the MOHAWK, ANGEL MONKEY, DEVIL MONKEY, four HAZMAT SUITS, CHIP, CRYSTAL MONKEY, the WIND-UP MONKEY, the COMEDY and TRAGEDY masks, the OLD GOALIE MASK, the GECKI TOP HAT, the 999 NEON HOODIE, the DJ FX looks (BEAT RINGS, NOTE DRIFT, BASS AURA), and a MONSTER PLUSH backpack for every monster.
- v14's costume line-up is in the shops: GLOOMSMAN, BILLOW, TINPLATE, MUD MONKEY, the SUGGESTION BOX set and the party hats.
- TAILOR, our new fitting system: tees and hoodies are back (BIG NOSE TEE, BIG NOSE HOODIE, CC HOODIE) and fit every body, class and full-body fur.
- Universal weapon wraps: every wrap fits every weapon.
- Lots more challenges, all on ONE CHALLENGE BOARD with tabs and pages. The dailies are on the DAILY board.
- A new app icon.

FIXED AND IMPROVED
- Grabbing: loose tools come to the palm that is on them, and back items draw cleanly over the shoulder.
- Arms after a teleport, the hub ramp, and a faster slide down to The Depths.
- Monster teeth sit inside their lips, faces animate at every distance, and eyes no longer poke through or stay open on a blink.
- The BOOMBOX keys need a real press, ride remotes and signs read the right way up, and held food shows in your hand.
- Every pet's nose sits straight, and the Surface signs, mushrooms and THE SNATCHER's spikes sit where they should.
- The titans stay on the ground, and THE HOLLOW starts in its cave.
- Rides are about 22 percent faster.
- The host leaving no longer breaks a room while a titan is alive.

Everyone in a room needs v15: v14 and v15 players can't join each other."
